- **2026-10-13 — Windows is a native release target (RUL16 (Windows is a native release target: same assets, an installer and launchers that need no POSIX shell)).** Owner decision: the level is "native, complete" (PowerShell and `cmd.exe`, no Git Bash, no WSL), with `tar.gz` kept as the single archive format and macOS left out of scope. Prior art, reused: the Windows CI hardening track made the Rust workspace build and the release-tree staging work on Windows (the `fgos.exe` entry, colon-free release store directory names, drive-letter-safe archive validation), and an earlier change wrote `.cmd` launchers on Windows that ran the `sh` shims through a `sh` on `PATH`; that required Git for Windows, so it is replaced by launchers that read `activation.json` themselves. Missing before: a Windows release asset, `install.ps1`, a Windows consumer proof, and any check that the launchers exist. Also in this change: the Linux asset moves from `ubuntu-latest` (binaries then needed glibc 2.39 and printed a loader warning on Ubuntu 22.04, glibc 2.35) to `ubuntu-22.04`, with a CI gate on the glibc symbol versions.
- **2026-10-16 — fgOS has no npm runtime dependency; YAML is read through one vendored parser (RUL101 (fgOS has no npm runtime dependency; every YAML parse goes through one vendored js-yaml 5.4.3 behind src/util/yaml.mjs)).** Before this, `yaml` was the one production dependency. An installed release carried it (the release builder stages declared production dependencies), but a checkout, linked worktree or unpacked copy without `npm install` did not, so every module importing it failed to load there, and the doctor and setup paths grew their own YAML readers and "not evaluated" branches to keep loading. Decision: `package.json#dependencies` stays empty; the only YAML parser is `src/util/third-party/js-yaml.mjs`, the ESM bundle from the js-yaml 5.4.3 tarball, unmodified except a header and the dropped source-map comment line, and every parse goes through `src/util/yaml.mjs` (`parseYaml(text, { filename })`: zero documents give `null`, more than one throws, `maxAliases` 100, js-yaml's default core schema). An architecture test fails on any other import of `yaml`, `js-yaml` or the third-party file. Rejected: keeping `yaml` and making doctor tolerate its absence (what the workarounds did, and the cause of the divergence); a hand-rolled parser (a second authority for what YAML means); `vendor/` or `dist/` as the location (the repository's scout-block hook refuses those path segments, so agents could not read or review the file); 5.4.2 (a block-indentation mis-parse fixed in 5.4.3) and 5.5.0 (one day old at the time). Readers that used to skip silently now report a parse failure as a named problem with file, line and column; pinned persona text that the strict parser rejects renders through a private legacy projection so older runs resume with the same text (its removal is tracked in the backlog). Evidence: commits `8ef1baf1c` (door and vendored file), `838b044e5` (call sites), `b75c01a3f` (release and dev-host staging), `6013ca389` (dependency dropped), `f96eece77`, `b7eeb4bb6` and `26b3338a7` (readers use the parser), `f705b9c8c` (doctor checks `compiled.json`); a parity run of the old parser against the door over every tracked YAML and frontmatter document found 828 documents, 0 differences, 13 rejected by both; a cold `fgos` start costs 2 to 3 ms more (97 to 99 ms for `version`, 109 to 110 ms for `dispatch decide`); the full suite ran 7850 tests with 0 failures with release binaries present; `test/util/yaml.test.mjs` pins the vendored bytes by hash. Kept on their own paths: `src/report/frontmatter.mjs` pairs `parseFrontmatter` with `renderFrontmatter` over a deliberately flat schema, so replacing only the parser would make the pair asymmetric; `distill.mjs` carries a minimal YAML reader because portable skills ship without `src/`; `domains/*/compiled.json` stays a generated projection because parsing domain YAML at import would put every verb, hook and `doctor` at the mercy of one YAML typo (doctor now checks its freshness instead). Upgrade procedure: in an empty scratch directory run `npm pack js-yaml@<version> --ignore-scripts`; compare the tarball's sha512 with `npm view js-yaml@<version> dist.integrity`; extract the `.mjs` bundle from the tarball without executing anything in it (build the path so the hook-refused segment does not appear in the command); confirm it has no import or require; diff it against the current bundle and read every changed line; re-run the parity comparison against the previous parser over the tracked YAML; replace the third-party file with the new bundle under a fresh header (source, version, integrity, license, hash); update the hash constant in `test/util/yaml.test.mjs`. js-yaml advisories are watched through the backlog, since `npm audit` no longer covers the file.
- **2026-10-17 — Instruction composition belongs to the Agent Context Engine; packaging-distribution delivers (RUL102 (one owner for composing agent instructions: the Agent Context Engine composes and selects rules, packaging-distribution only discovers, installs, renders per host and repairs)).** Before this, two documents gave the same authority to two components: `docs/platform/packaging-distribution/contracts/instruction-composition-and-projection.md` §2 named packaging-distribution owner of the composition engine and registry shape, while `docs/platform/proposals/documentation-system-unification.md` §4.7.2-4.7.3 put the Instruction Composer in the Agent Context Engine and said packaging-distribution "does not decide semantic composition". Left as is, a future Agent Context Engine would be built beside `src/setup/instruction-composition.mjs`, giving two composers and two orderings of the same rules. Owner decision: composing and selecting rules (kind order, override, conflict, per-task selection, per-host budget, progressive disclosure) has one owner, the Agent Context Engine; packaging-distribution keeps delivery (source discovery and install, per-host render adapters, projection ledger, doctor repair). Two delivery moments follow: static delivery, where packaging-distribution asks the engine for each host's effective set when sources change or at setup/install/upgrade and renders it to files; and per-task delivery, where the runner asks the engine for a context packet that goes into the worker brief, with no file written. The engine knows no host or file. Rejected: packaging-distribution keeping composition and also absorbing budgets and per-task selection (it would grow a content-deciding role inside an install/delivery component). Weight guard: no new component now; the existing code in `src/setup/instruction-registry.mjs` and `src/setup/instruction-composition.mjs` is the engine's seed and moves to its own module only when the first budget/tiering slice lands, in the same change, never kept in two places. Evidence and reasoning: `plans/reports/research-261016-1118-agent-code-quality-guardrails.md` sections 2d and 6.

priorPassage.sample: **Architecture advisory — current boundary.** `core/skills/fgos-architecture-panel/SKILL.md` starts registered Workflows, reads settled reports, and exposes public `workflow status
priorPassage.text:
**Architecture advisory — current boundary.** `core/skills/fgos-architecture-panel/SKILL.md` starts registered Workflows, reads settled reports, and exposes public `workflow status`/`workflow answer` commands for the owner's declared gate; it owns no raw run-state driver or executor roster. `architecture-advisory` has five linear execution steps plus human close, with distinct panel-seat lenses and reviewed/high final synthesis; `architecture-advisory-reopen` revisits parent reports through synthesis → explanation → close without blind seats. Both synthesis templates require reviewer and red-team regardless of configured high-rigor checker defaults. Executor/provider/model/invocation selection remains config + `bind()` owned. Required read-only posture refuses unsafe execution.
`council-lite` is a one-panel discussion Workflow: `params.roleTasks` gives each seat one task posture from `core/agents/council-*.yaml`, supplied through template `contextRefs`. Each description contains method, blind spot, and an explicit evidence-led ending rule; posture is not actor identity, registry membership, or provider policy. `bind()` spreads seats across provider families as a preference (decision 0055), never refusing a seat for sharing one. No runtime or renderer seam is added. Each seat first writes a short "Restatement" of the question and what it treats as out of scope before analysing, and the synthesizer lists mismatched restatements as unresolved evidence.
`workflow start --seats "<lens>|<lens>|..."` rebuilds a registered base whose panels are generic (`group-cognition`, `business-discussion`, `nominal-group`, `delphi`) with one panel seat per lens (decision 0056). A panel unit is generic when its `params.roleTasks` has no `panelist-N` key and it sets no custom `params.role`; a base with no generic panel, or with any curated one (`council-lite`, `architecture-advisory`), is refused with the reason, so lenses never overwrite curated seats. The Workflow component (`src/workflow/seats.mjs`, called from `prepareWorkflowRun`) clones the loaded base and, on every generic panel unit, sets `params.members = N` and `roleTasks.panelist-1..N` from one runtime-owned sentence that frames the lens as a task focus and ends in `{objective}`; Delphi gets the same seats in both rounds so `sameSeat` inputs stay aligned. Steps, `dependsOn`, gates, `blind`, checker and synthesizer text are untouched and the result is revalidated by the same validator. Entries: at least 2, no schema maximum, distinct case-insensitively; a lens is 3-160 characters on one line without braces or `|`; an entry `@name` (`[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}` after the `@`) seats a named persona on that panel seat alone (decision 0057). Run-level `--context-ref` reaches only root steps, so with `--seats` the shared refs are also copied into the template of every unit in a step that depends on another. Before the run is recorded the CLI dry-binds the expanded panel units (`preflightWorkflowSeats`, `simulateUnitBindings`): seats that would share a provider family are returned as `seatsPreflight.warnings` (informational), and a role no candidate can serve refuses the start; nothing is created in either case. The expanded definition is stored in the existing `workflow.start` event with a provenance record `seats: { seats, baseId, baseDigest, refs }` and the status projection exposes `seats`; resume and status read stored data and never re-expand, and `workflow resume --seats` refuses seats that differ from the stored ones. Without `--seats` the definition, event and projection are unchanged.
A named persona is looked up once by `src/runner/agent-definitions.mjs`: workspace `fgos/agents/<name>.yaml` of the working project, then `domains/*/agents/`, then `core/agents/` (a project without its own `domains/` or `core/agents/` folder reads the installed package's), whole-file replacement across tiers, two files of one name in one tier is an error, an unknown name is an error that lists every folder searched, and a file must declare `name:` equal to its basename and a non-empty `description:`. `prepareWorkflowRun` resolves every name before the run exists and records `seats.personas: [{ seat, name, tier, source, digest, text }]` (the exact file bytes and their SHA-256) in the same `workflow.start` event; the status projection exposes it. Một cờ ở Unit (và ở `template` của Workflow): `blind: true` làm *mọi vai* của Unit chạy với `hostRead: blind` (`docs/specs/confinement-authority.md` §9.2): worker không đọc được `.fgos/assignments`, `.fgos/workflow-runs`, `.fgos/dispatch-runs` của project, thư mục socket herdr, private home của dispatch khác, hay `/proc/<pid>` của tiến trình anh em; chỉ đọc được thư mục của chính nó (brief, ref đã được trao — chỉ-đọc) và ghi outbox. Phần còn lại của host (repo, `node`, DNS) và file tracked trong `.fgos` không đổi. Unit `blind` không bao giờ chạy không-blind: nếu không thực thi được — `bind()` không chọn in-process/inline, không có bwrap, mode không `required`, probe hỏng/chưa tươi, `cwd` hay ref nằm trong vùng bị che — dispatch bị từ chối trước khi spawn với lý do có tên (`blind-in-process`, `blind-requires-confinement`, `blind-hides-workspace`, `blind-ref-hidden`, `confinement-probe-failed`, ...). Với Unit `blind`, input `unit-run:`/`gate-answer:` (và ref bất kỳ nằm trong vùng bị che) không được giao bằng đường dẫn gốc: lúc dispatch, `resolveUnitInputs` + `copyHandoffsInto` chép nguyên byte (kiểm sha256) vào `inputs/` của round dir của chính vai đó, mỗi vai một bản, tên trung tính khi có `anonymizeInputs`; `unit.json` giữ `inputMap`, resume dùng lại bản chép. `blind-ref-hidden` chỉ còn cho ref không chép được. priorPassage.text:
- **Trạng thái:** Settled (Request-to-Run P1 Execution Core hoàn tất, 2026-10-01)
- **Bối cảnh:** L5 trước P1 bị phân mảnh: "ai làm" bị quyết định ở nhiều nơi (coordination engine, `decide`, placement-policy, `assignment-policy.mjs`); "chạy qua cửa nào" có nhiều cửa ad-hoc; read-only bị chia rẽ giữa invocation `*-readonly` và tool gating; cổng ghi file phụ thuộc template stamp của engine.
- **Quyết định:**
  1. **Hợp đồng Unit (`src/runner/execution/unit.mjs`):** Hợp đồng dữ liệu duy nhất cho mọi đường vào. Phi hạ tầng (G2) — cấm chứa executor/provider/model/tier/invocation/actors/prefer/overrides.
  2. **Một `bind()` duy nhất (`src/runner/execution/bind.mjs`):** Bảng 5 mức (Session -> Overrides -> Unit role/rigor -> Project taste -> Global taste), tái dùng `mechanism.mjs` theo D-ADR0033 (một cơ chế dispatch).
  3. **Một cửa chạy `fgos run` (`src/runner/execution/run.mjs`):** Bọc `executeAssignment`, mặc định spawn qua pane herdr (G7), cli fallback. Có `fgos run record` cho producer inline với nonce một lần phát kèm chỉ dẫn và kiểm chứng `evidenceRefs`.
  4. **3 Pattern cộng tác (`solo`, `reviewed`, `panel`):** Vòng lặp code nhỏ, thuần, không store mới (Q-B: trạng thái vòng lặp suy từ `history()` của Unit run). `findings` là outcome, không đánh `failed`.
  5. **Cổng ghi file kiểm chứng được (supersede ADR-006 §6):** Assignment `mutating` được admit khi: (a) cwd là linked worktree và `realpath(cwd) == unit.json.worktree`, (b) `bind()` tính lại từ `unit.json` khớp deep-equal. Ngoại lệ có tên: engine protocol stamp giữ tới P4 phase 6. D-ADR0033 (một cơ chế dispatch) giữ nguyên.

0048 — P2 Plan chạy được: Unit cho mọi đường vào, driver mỏng fgos-run, bỏ DemandFacts/matcher
priorPassage.text:
- **Trạng thái:** Settled (Request-to-Run P2 Runnable Plans hoàn tất, 2026-10-01)
- **Bối cảnh:** Trước P2, việc phân rã và chọn capability/cơ chế bị phân mảnh bởi lớp prose L2 DemandFacts (8 fields) -> matcher -> `form` (`inline|protocol|facade`). Các facade `fgos-code-change`, `fgos-code-panel`, `fgos-plan-loop` tự lập lịch, tự chạy vòng lặp bằng prose, tạo ra nhiều sequencer chồng chéo và gắn chặt vào domain coding.
- **Quyết định:**
  1. **Unit là hợp đồng dữ liệu duy nhất (`src/runner/execution/unit.mjs`):** Mọi đường vào (prompt tự do, plan AgentKit, phase file) đều quy về Unit. `fgos plan-lint` kiểm chứng Unit trong phase file (`## Units`, `- unit:`), phát hiện sớm ghim hạ tầng (G2), trùng id, vòng phụ thuộc, và giao nhau `writes` không có `dependsOn`.
  2. **Driver mỏng (`core/skills/fgos-run`):** Thay thế toàn bộ các facade cũ (`fgos-code-change`, `fgos-code-panel`, `fgos-plan-loop`, `fgos-capability-dispatching`). Driver không tự lập lịch, không tự merge mà giao trọn cho **Workflow runner** (`src/workflow/runner.mjs`, P3a).
  3. **Cổng người thống nhất:** Authorize không parse từ prose plan. Phase chưa được duyệt sẽ dừng ở cổng người của Workflow run (`gate: { kind: "human" }`), owner trả lời qua `fgos workflow answer`. Mọi câu hỏi treo được gom thành một bộ duy nhất. Mọi cổng người mặc định là consent gate (`mode: "consent"`, fail-closed): chỉ nhả runner khi trả lời kèm `--approve`; trả lời không có `--approve` là lời làm rõ (clarification note) và gate giữ nguyên `parked`. Cổng nào chủ động khai `mode: "input"` thì câu trả lời nội dung là đủ để tiến bước.
  4. **Xoá bỏ DemandFacts & matcher:** Xoá `src/runner/capability-match.mjs`, verb `fgos capability match`, các fragment `capability-matching.md`. L2 chỉ còn hiểu yêu cầu và viết Unit với `capability` (`domain:verb`).
Đổi quyết định này = supersede bằng record mới, không sửa tại chỗ.

0053 — Một cơ chế truyền kết quả: đường dẫn report trong contextRefs, phân giải một lần
priorPassage.text:
- **Trạng thái:** Settled (2026-10-05)
- **Bối cảnh:** Có hai đường truyền kết quả. Giữa các vai trong một Unit run là đường dẫn trong `contextRefs`; giữa các bước Workflow là text nhúng vào objective, tối đa 6000 ký tự của report cuối mỗi unit, tìm report bằng tên file (`agent-report.md`) nên bỏ sót `report-N.md` của herdr, và chỉ giữ kết quả cuối nên một bước `panel` chỉ còn synthesizer. Ref `unit-run:<id>/<role>` được validate nhưng không bao giờ phân giải, worker nhận một chuỗi không phải đường dẫn. Store của Workflow không giữ unit run id nên không dựng được ref.
- **Quyết định:**
  1. **Một dạng:** đường dẫn tuyệt đối, chỉ đọc, tới report, trong `contextRefs`; không còn đường nhúng text. Xoá giới hạn 6000 ký tự, tìm report theo tên file và `role-input-refs.mjs`.
  2. **Một chỗ phân giải** trong Execution Core (`handoff-refs.mjs`), lúc tạo Unit run, kết quả ghi vào `unit.json` (`resolvedInputs`). Report lấy từ `settleReports` (đã kiểm sha256), không đoán theo tên file.
  3. **Workflow store ghi `unitRunId`** ngay khi Unit run được tạo (event `unit.started`, trước ghế đầu tiên) và lặp lại trên `unit.complete`; một unit đang `running` có id được runner tiếp tục bằng `resumeUnitRunId` (ghế đã settle không chạy lại, worktree đã ghi được dùng lại) thay vì tạo Unit run mới; bước sau thấy report của mọi vai của mọi bước phụ thuộc, như trước.
  4. Không mở rộng quyền đọc của worker (xem "Ranh giới tin cậy" ở `docs/routing-handoff-contract.md`); không đổi ranh giới component.
- **Giới hạn đã biết:** worker phải mở file; câu `Summary` giữ trong objective làm sàn khi một model bỏ qua ref. Câu trả lời của cổng người chưa tới unit sau.
Đổi quyết định này = supersede bằng record mới, không sửa tại chỗ.

  2. **Một chỗ phân giải** trong Execution Core (`handoff-refs.mjs`), lúc tạo Unit run, kết quả ghi vào `unit.json` (`resolvedInputs`). Report lấy từ `settleReports` (đã kiểm sha256), không đoán theo tên file.
  3. **Workflow store ghi `unitRunId`** ngay khi Unit run được tạo (event `unit.started`, trước ghế đầu tiên) và lặp lại trên `unit.complete`; một unit đang `running` có id được runner tiếp tục bằng `resumeUnitRunId` (ghế đã settle không chạy lại, worktree đã ghi được dùng lại) thay vì tạo Unit run mới; bước sau thấy report của mọi vai của mọi bước phụ thuộc, như trước.
  4. Không mở rộng quyền đọc của worker (xem "Ranh giới tin cậy" ở `docs/routing-handoff-contract.md`); không đổi ranh giới component.
- **Giới hạn đã biết:** worker phải mở file; câu `Summary` giữ trong objective làm sàn khi một model bỏ qua ref. Câu trả lời của cổng người chưa tới unit sau.

0050 — P6 Nối thật: herdr là transport mặc định, posture một đường, fallback quota qua pane mới
priorPassage.text:
- **Trạng thái:** Settled cho ca 1, 2, 3, 4, 6; ca 5 NOT RUN (xem bằng chứng)
- **Bối cảnh:** Sau 0047, `bind().transport`, `resolvePosture` và `nextCandidate` tồn tại nhưng không ai gọi: mọi lần chạy thật là cli headless, posture tự dựng `bwrapArgs` riêng song song với driver confinement, `canApplyPosture` luôn `true`.
- **Quyết định:**
  1. **Transport do `bind()` quyết, `run.mjs` đọc.** herdr khi herdr có mặt trong session **và** executor có invocation `herdr-spawn` có id mà `canApplyPosture` chấp nhận; ngược lại cli (lý do ghi ở `provenance.transport.source`). Transport và invocation thật nằm trong `assignment.json` / `unit.json`, không chỉ ở giá trị trả về. Executor có CLI vẫn out-of-process (D-ADR0033 (một cơ chế dispatch, executor có CLI luôn chạy ngoài process)).
  2. **Posture một đường.** `resolvePosture` chỉ ánh xạ posture -> `requirement` (policy built-in); `requirement` đi vào `buildConfinementRequest` -> Confinement Authority -> driver bwrap, cho cả pane herdr lẫn cli. Không còn `bwrapArgs` tự dựng trong `policies.mjs` (guard test). `resolvePostureInvocation` (`canApplyPosture` là dạng boolean của nó) là nơi duy nhất quyết: invocation khai `confinement.backend`, backend bật trong registry máy, executable chạy được; thiếu thì bind lọc candidate hoặc từ chối `posture-unavailable`, không chạy không confine. Nó cũng trả về invocation đã duyệt: khi `prefer` không nêu invocation, bind ghi đúng invocation cli thường đầu tiên mang được posture (không phải invocation cli đầu tiên của executor; `herdr-spawn` chỉ tính khi session ở trong herdr) vào binding, và `run.mjs` ghim đúng nó. Entry `prefer` nêu invocation thì giữ nguyên. Nên mọi invocation muốn được chọn phải khai `confinement`, và invocation của agent ghi state ngoài thư mục chỉ-đọc (codex, agy, pi) phải khai thêm `resourceBindings` private-home.
  5. **Tra capability.** `bind()` tìm `capabilities[domain:verb]` trước, rồi `capabilities[verb]`, nhưng entry chỉ thắng khi có `prefer` dùng được: slot chỉ có `description` (loại `fgos setup` ghi) không che bare-verb có `prefer`. Không có `prefer` ở đâu cả thì headless bị từ chối `headless-no-executor`; `fgos doctor` (`workflow-capabilities-configured`) cảnh báo đúng capability đó. Mặc định headless chỉ chạy được với Workflow đã khai `prefer`, không phải mọi Workflow `fgos setup` đã ghi slot.
  3. **Fallback quota.** `provider-limit` (herdr đọc màn hình qua detector của herdr, mặc định idle 5 phút nếu config không đặt `idleTimeoutMs`) -> `nextCandidate` đi tiếp `prefer[]` -> pane mới dưới assignment id `<unitRun>/<role>/<round>-fb<n>`; pane cũ giữ nguyên; `fallbackFrom` ghi lại; hết candidate thì outcome vẫn `provider-limit`. cli-spawn không có phát hiện limit nên headless không fallback (*cập nhật 2026-10-14:* nay có, qua câu hạn mức ở đuôi stderr, xem đoạn decision 0058 ở RUL65b). Pane idle (không `working`) quá 15 giây bị đọc màn hình để tìm credential chết (`AUTH_FAILURE_PATTERNS`, vd pi "OAuth refresh failed ... invalid_grant"): thấy thì cũng kết thúc `provider-limit` ngay, không chờ idle timeout, để walk sang candidate kế; classifier ghi quarantine `auth-token` kiểu `manual-clear` (tới khi người login lại và `fgos dispatch reconcile provider-capacity clear-quarantine`), không phải `quota-limit`. Quarantine quota dùng đúng thời gian reset provider ghi trên màn hình ("Resets in 24m1s", cả giờ/phút/giây), mặc định 1 giờ khi không ghi.
  4. **Pane confine cho cả năm họ** (claude, claude qua OpenRouter, codex, agy, pi): mỗi agent giữ state trong private home dựng từ account được lease; công thức và lý do ở [confinement-authority.md §13.1](./confinement-authority.md), account inventory toàn máy ở RUL65b (trên).
  - **Pane không nhận HOME riêng của worker.** Vòng herdr confine mở pane không kèm `HOME` private (launcher script tự `export` nó trước khi `exec`): shell của pane mà bắt đầu trong một home không có file khởi động thì zsh chạy trình hướng dẫn lần đầu và nuốt lệnh khởi chạy gõ ngay sau, nên vòng agy báo `foreground process ... does not match prepared command argv` dù argv không sai.
  - **Prompt delivery trong pane herdr (`inline` mặc định, `file-pointer` tuỳ chọn).** Mặc định `herdr-spawn` gửi toàn bộ nội dung `brief-<round>.md` trực tiếp vào pane qua `herdr agent prompt` (bracketed paste) để người quan sát thấy trọn vẹn prompt trong TUI, đồng thời vẫn ghi `brief-<round>.md` xuống đĩa kèm dòng trỏ đường dẫn phục hồi sau compaction; `promptDelivery: "file-pointer"` (hoặc `FGOS_HERDR_PROMPT_DELIVERY=file-pointer`) giữ cơ chế gõ con trỏ một dòng. `confirmBriefSubmitted` nhận diện cả paste chip thu gọn (`[Pasted text #1 +N lines]`, `[paste #1 +N lines]`, `[Paste]`, `#1 … +N lines`, menu `Pasted N lines`) ở vùng composer cuối màn hình; `SHELL_MANAGED_ENV` giữ nguyên `TERM`/`HERDR_PANE_ID` của pane mới (không để `TERM=dumb` hay `HERDR_PANE_ID` của process gọi ghi đè), `workerBaseEnv` loại bỏ `OMPCODE`/`OMP_PROFILE`/`PI_PROFILE`/`PI_CONFIG_FILES` của phiên cha, và `executors.xai` có thêm invocation `omp-herdr-vantt` chạy `omp` trong pane `bwrap`.
- **Bằng chứng:** [acceptance-herdr.md](../../plans/261002-1339-request-to-run-p6-herdr-posture-quota/reports/acceptance-herdr.md): ca 1 (Unit `reviewed`), 2 (reviewer bị chặn ghi repo, ghi được outbox), 3 (Workflow `architecture-advisory` 9 role trong pane, 4 họ provider), 4 (fallback, pane cũ giữ), 6 (headless cli cùng posture) Accepted; transport đọc từ `assignment.json`.
- **Giới hạn đã biết:**
  - Ca 5 (so cùng câu hỏi với engine cũ, tag `pre-engine-retirement`) **NOT RUN**: engine cũ cần Lead tự viết và authorize từng bước, nên "Lead-active" sẽ đo chính thao tác tay, không đo engine.
  - Ca 4 dùng màn hình limit **giả** (executor `fake-limit`); `DEFAULT_USAGE_LIMIT_PATTERNS` chưa đo trên màn hình limit thật của claude/codex. *Cập nhật 2026-10-05:* câu chữ đo được đầu tiên là của codex, "■ Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model." (đã thêm vào mẫu mặc định). Ngoài ra, thang liveness chỉ đọc màn hình khi tiến độ dừng, mà `working` tính là tiến độ, nên pane vẫn báo `working` nhưng đang kẹt ở lỗi nhà cung cấp chạy tới trần 15 phút không fallback (thấy khi dogfood mdview). Nay vòng thăm dò đọc 15 dòng cuối của agent đang `working` mỗi 30 giây và kết luận `provider-limit` khi cùng một dòng bắt đầu bằng dấu lỗi của CLI (`■`) và nêu điều kiện (`WORKING_STALL_PATTERNS`, chỉ câu chữ đã đo) còn nằm đó sau một khoảng thăm dò đầy đủ; chữ thường nhắc tới capacity hay rate limit không bị đụng tới.
  - **Trạng thái agent trong herdr (đo 2026-10-05, herdr 0.9.1-vantt.1).** herdr có đúng một nguồn trạng thái cho mỗi pane; fgos từng `pane report-agent --state working` lúc khởi động pane bị cô lập, nên fgos thành nguồn đó và `agent get` đứng yên ở `working` cả vòng (commit `2e9b53f6c` chỉ là đường vòng: đọc `agent explain` trước, hai lần gọi herdr mỗi nhịp thăm dò). Thí nghiệm trong pane thật: claude, codex, agy, pi chạy sau bwrap (không tách pid namespace) đều được herdr nhận ra không cần `HERDR_AGENT`, `agent get` khớp `agent explain`, và `agent prompt --wait` trả `done` sau ~2 giây; sau khi fgos báo `working`, `agent get` kẹt `working` còn `explain` nói `idle`, `agent prompt --wait` quá thời gian; `pane release-agent` trả lại quyền, trạng thái hồi phục sau vài giây. Nay fgos không báo trạng thái; chỉ khi herdr không nhận ra tiến trình là agent (sau 6 giây) mới báo, vì đó là cách duy nhất đánh địa chỉ nó (`ensureHerdrKnowsAgent`). Vòng thăm dò đọc `agent get`, chỉ hỏi `explain` khi `unknown`. Giới hạn: herdr chỉ biết `idle/working/blocked/done/unknown`, không biết lý do; manifest codex khớp ký tự xoay trong tiêu đề terminal là `working` (rule `osc_title_working`), nên pane codex kẹt ở lỗi nhà cung cấp vẫn là `working` và vẫn cần phần đọc màn hình ở trên. Mỗi vòng không bình thường để lại `herdr-diagnosis.json` (lời giải thích của chính herdr).
  - **Agent kẹt ở prompt chỉ người trả lời được (đo 2026-10-05, codex "Trust this folder?").** herdr báo đúng `blocked` (luật `trust_directory`), thang liveness kết luận `blocked` kèm dòng màn hình, nhưng bước settle coi mọi lỗi mang lớp `worker-timeout` là timeout nên run ghi `execution-timeout` và Unit ra `execution-failure`. Nay `blocked` (như `provider-limit`) đi thẳng qua `adapterOutcome`: `failure.code = blocked`, `outcome.category = blocked`, Unit outcome `blocked`, pane giữ nguyên, thông báo nêu cách sửa (trả lời prompt hoặc cấp trust cho project trong home của agent). Không thêm mẫu màn hình vì detector của herdr đã nhận ra màn hình này; màn hình không đọc được vẫn không phải bằng chứng.
  - Inventory account (`runner.providers.<provider>.accounts`) chỉ ở `~/.fgos/config.json` toàn máy; mỗi máy phải tự khai, `fgos setup` không tạo; `fgos doctor` (`confined-pane-accounts`) đọc inventory từ config toàn máy bất kể cwd (không cần project config) và chỉ ra pane thiếu entry; config toàn máy không đọc được thì check FAIL, nêu mã lỗi và đường dẫn.
  - bind chọn invocation herdr **đầu tiên** của executor; executor nhiều account cần luật chọn tường minh về sau.
Đổi quyết định này = supersede bằng record mới, không sửa tại chỗ.

  - **Prompt delivery trong pane herdr (`inline` mặc định, `file-pointer` tuỳ chọn).** Mặc định `herdr-spawn` gửi toàn bộ nội dung `brief-<round>.md` trực tiếp vào pane qua `herdr agent prompt` (bracketed paste) để người quan sát thấy trọn vẹn prompt trong TUI, đồng thời vẫn ghi `brief-<round>.md` xuống đĩa kèm dòng trỏ đường dẫn phục hồi sau compaction; `promptDelivery: "file-pointer"` (hoặc `FGOS_HERDR_PROMPT_DELIVERY=file-pointer`) giữ cơ chế gõ con trỏ một dòng. `confirmBriefSubmitted` nhận diện cả paste chip thu gọn (`[Pasted text #1 +N lines]`, `[paste #1 +N lines]`, `[Paste]`, `#1 … +N lines`, menu `Pasted N lines`) ở vùng composer cuối màn hình; `SHELL_MANAGED_ENV` giữ nguyên `TERM`/`HERDR_PANE_ID` của pane mới (không để `TERM=dumb` hay `HERDR_PANE_ID` của process gọi ghi đè), `workerBaseEnv` loại bỏ `OMPCODE`/`OMP_PROFILE`/`PI_PROFILE`/`PI_CONFIG_FILES` của phiên cha, và `executors.xai` có thêm invocation `omp-herdr-vantt` chạy `omp` trong pane `bwrap`.
- **Bằng chứng:** [acceptance-herdr.md](../../plans/261002-1339-request-to-run-p6-herdr-posture-quota/reports/acceptance-herdr.md): ca 1 (Unit `reviewed`), 2 (reviewer bị chặn ghi repo, ghi được outbox), 3 (Workflow `architecture-advisory` 9 role trong pane, 4 họ provider), 4 (fallback, pane cũ giữ), 6 (headless cli cùng posture) Accepted; transport đọc từ `assignment.json`.
- **Giới hạn đã biết:**
  - Ca 5 (so cùng câu hỏi với engine cũ, tag `pre-engine-retirement`) **NOT RUN**: engine cũ cần Lead tự viết và authorize từng bước, nên "Lead-active" sẽ đo chính thao tác tay, không đo engine.
  - Ca 4 dùng màn hình limit **giả** (executor `fake-limit`); `DEFAULT_USAGE_LIMIT_PATTERNS` chưa đo trên màn hình limit thật của claude/codex. *Cập nhật 2026-10-05:* câu chữ đo được đầu tiên là của codex, "■ Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model." (đã thêm vào mẫu mặc định). Ngoài ra, thang liveness chỉ đọc màn hình khi tiến độ dừng, mà `working` tính là tiến độ, nên pane vẫn báo `working` nhưng đang kẹt ở lỗi nhà cung cấp chạy tới trần 15 phút không fallback (thấy khi dogfood mdview). Nay vòng thăm dò đọc 15 dòng cuối của agent đang `working` mỗi 30 giây và kết luận `provider-limit` khi cùng một dòng bắt đầu bằng dấu lỗi của CLI (`■`) và nêu điều kiện (`WORKING_STALL_PATTERNS`, chỉ câu chữ đã đo) còn nằm đó sau một khoảng thăm dò đầy đủ; chữ thường nhắc tới capacity hay rate limit không bị đụng tới.
  - **Trạng thái agent trong herdr (đo 2026-10-05, herdr 0.9.1-vantt.1).** herdr có đúng một nguồn trạng thái cho mỗi pane; fgos từng `pane report-agent --state working` lúc khởi động pane bị cô lập, nên fgos thành nguồn đó và `agent get` đứng yên ở `working` cả vòng (commit `2e9b53f6c` chỉ là đường vòng: đọc `agent explain` trước, hai lần gọi herdr mỗi nhịp thăm dò). Thí nghiệm trong pane thật: claude, codex, agy, pi chạy sau bwrap (không tách pid namespace) đều được herdr nhận ra không cần `HERDR_AGENT`, `agent get` khớp `agent explain`, và `agent prompt --wait` trả `done` sau ~2 giây; sau khi fgos báo `working`, `agent get` kẹt `working` còn `explain` nói `idle`, `agent prompt --wait` quá thời gian; `pane release-agent` trả lại quyền, trạng thái hồi phục sau vài giây. Nay fgos không báo trạng thái; chỉ khi herdr không nhận ra tiến trình là agent (sau 6 giây) mới báo, vì đó là cách duy nhất đánh địa chỉ nó (`ensureHerdrKnowsAgent`). Vòng thăm dò đọc `agent get`, chỉ hỏi `explain` khi `unknown`. Giới hạn: herdr chỉ biết `idle/working/blocked/done/unknown`, không biết lý do; manifest codex khớp ký tự xoay trong tiêu đề terminal là `working` (rule `osc_title_working`), nên pane codex kẹt ở lỗi nhà cung cấp vẫn là `working` và vẫn cần phần đọc màn hình ở trên. Mỗi vòng không bình thường để lại `herdr-diagnosis.json` (lời giải thích của chính herdr).
  - **Agent kẹt ở prompt chỉ người trả lời được (đo 2026-10-05, codex "Trust this folder?").** herdr báo đúng `blocked` (luật `trust_directory`), thang liveness kết luận `blocked` kèm dòng màn hình, nhưng bước settle coi mọi lỗi mang lớp `worker-timeout` là timeout nên run ghi `execution-timeout` và Unit ra `execution-failure`. Nay `blocked` (như `provider-limit`) đi thẳng qua `adapterOutcome`: `failure.code = blocked`, `outcome.category = blocked`, Unit outcome `blocked`, pane giữ nguyên, thông báo nêu cách sửa (trả lời prompt hoặc cấp trust cho project trong home của agent). Không thêm mẫu màn hình vì detector của herdr đã nhận ra màn hình này; màn hình không đọc được vẫn không phải bằng chứng.
  - Inventory account (`runner.providers.<provider>.accounts`) chỉ ở `~/.fgos/config.json` toàn máy; mỗi máy phải tự khai, `fgos setup` không tạo; `fgos doctor` (`confined-pane-accounts`) đọc inventory từ config toàn máy bất kể cwd (không cần project config) và chỉ ra pane thiếu entry; config toàn máy không đọc được thì check FAIL, nêu mã lỗi và đường dẫn.
  - bind chọn invocation herdr **đầu tiên** của executor; executor nhiều account cần luật chọn tường minh về sau.
Đổi quyết định này = supersede bằng record mới, không sửa tại chỗ.

priorPassage.text:
| Component | Current role | Current source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Work Lifecycle Engine / Work Driver | Domain-agnostic work-unit lifecycle, status board, claim/return, human gates. Does not own stage or sequencing (owned by Workflow runner). Owns worker slots (`OccupancyPort`), and fail-safe claim settlement (`fgos return --to blocked`). | [../architect/component-boundary/component-boundary-advisory.md](../architect/component-boundary/component-boundary-advisory.md) |
| Workflow (Định nghĩa + Run + Runner + Tích hợp) | Domain-neutral step & Unit DAG scheduling (`src/workflow/**`), human review gates. A consumer of Git's Land and Sync; owns no git mutation of its own. Single sequencer for plans, workflows, and multi-unit tasks. | [../specs/runner.md](../specs/runner.md) |
| Execution Core (Unit, Unit run, `bind()`, Pattern cộng tác, cửa `fgos run`, posture) | Single authority for "ai làm / model / persona / cơ chế" (`src/runner/execution/bind.mjs`), single run door for new work (`fgos run` via `src/runner/execution/run.mjs`, herdr pane default, cli fallback), OS confinement posture for both herdr and cli, verifiable mutating gate. Strictly forbids L3 Work lifecycle dependencies (`src/state/**`). | [../specs/runner.md](../specs/runner.md) |
| Collaboration Patterns (Execution Core) | Domain-neutral small collaboration loops (`solo`, `reviewed`, `panel`) and presets (`consult`, `research-fan-out`, `rfc`). Replaces retired coordination engine. | [../specs/runner.md](../specs/runner.md) |
| Herdr (Transport chính + Bề mặt quan sát) | Transport mặc định cho out-of-process runs, pane execution liveness, plugin `herdr-dashboard/` (TUI trong pane herdr + pick/pane supervisor; herdr nạp qua `herdr-plugin.toml`). | [../specs/herdr-web-dashboard.md](../specs/herdr-web-dashboard.md) |
| fgos Gateway | Tiến trình detached duy nhất phục vụ REST API (`/v1`, hợp đồng CTR010), MCP `search`/`execute` trên cùng cổng, và bundle web dashboard nhúng sẵn (`apps/fgos-gateway/`: `gateway.rs`, `mcp.rs`, `cf_access.rs`, `remote_invocation.rs`, `web/`). Vòng đời duy nhất qua `fgos gateway start\|status\|stop`; không phải một phần của herdr và không phải "herdr-gateway" (tên đó chỉ repo tham chiếu ngoài). Dùng chung với `herdr-dashboard` lớp adapter CLI fgos tại `packages/herdr-fgos-common/rust` (`fgos.rs`, `settings.rs`, trait `WorkItemSource`). | [../specs/herdr-web-dashboard.md](../specs/herdr-web-dashboard.md) |
| Dispatch Transport & Confinement | Machine backend registry, isolation confinement (`bwrap` v1 driver, attestation storage, fail-closed probes), executor adapters; the `bwrap` driver calls the credential renewal module at provisioning (`copyCredentialFiles`, the write-back marker) and removing a private home (`confinement/cleanup.mjs`) calls it again for write-back (dependency confinement → provider capacity, for the account lock only). | [../specs/confinement-authority.md](../specs/confinement-authority.md) |
| Run Result Evaluator | Evidence/confidence boundary for assignment run results. | [../architect/agent-coordination/architecture/evidence-and-results.md](../architect/agent-coordination/architecture/evidence-and-results.md) |
| Domain Components And Extension Layer | Domain-specific behavior, workflows, skills, task specs, doctrine. L2 prose no longer picks executors or mechanisms (lớp matching L2 cũ đã thu hồi per 0048); thin driver `fgos-run` delegates directly to Workflow runner and P1 Execution Core. | [../../domains/](../../domains/), [../architect/domainization/](../architect/domainization/) |
| Host And Surface Layer | CLI, fgos Gateway (REST/MCP/web), `herdr-dashboard` plugin and other Herdr surfaces into platform engines. | Host invocation and gateway docs |
| Packaging-Distribution | Runtime packaging, install, activation, setup/doctor readiness. | [packaging-distribution/README.md](packaging-distribution/README.md) |
| Knowledge, Learning, And Documentation Registry | Retrospective learning, doc registry, end-user docs index, trace/evolve signals. | Knowledge and docs registry docs |
| Observe (Metrics & Friction) | Measurement and friction tracking across substrate entities (cases, runs, sessions, friction, snapshots). Owned in Rust (`packages/observe/rust`), native routing. | [../specs/observe.md](../specs/observe.md) |
| Convention (Executable Names & Placement) | Platform-core authority for deterministic artifact names, repository-relative placement, path classification, and conformance checking. Implemented; owns no state and depends only on `fgos-host-runtime`. | [convention/spec.md](convention/spec.md) |
| Session Identity (Writer Identity) | Foundation authority for "who is the writer of this process" (`{id, source}`). One implementation, the Rust crate `fgos-session-identity` (`packages/session-identity/rust`, native verb `fgos identity`); Observe calls it in process, Node through the facade `src/util/session-identity.mjs`. Also mints the writer id of an attempt (`att-<attemptId>`, route `fgos internal identity mint-attempt`) and carries the launcher's env scrub the gate applies. Owns no state and depends only on `fgos-host-runtime`; Observe depends on it; the run supervisor's controller half calls the mint. Grants no lock or claim authority. | [session-identity/spec.md](session-identity/spec.md) |
| Terminal-control (L2) | Foundation component for "which pane does this key run in" on a terminal multiplexer, usable without a run. Rust crate `fgos-terminal-control` (`packages/terminal-control/rust`) with a key-addressed upper port and a driver port with declared capabilities (herdr first; Windows declares none). Writes only the allocation record; closes only panes it allocated, never a tab; Node reaches it through the internal route `fgos internal terminal-control`, no user verb. Dependency one way: run supervisor → Terminal-control (the supervisor holds the key, the attempt id, never a pane). Node migration done; setup adds the `terminal` config section and `<stateRoot>/terminal`, doctor runs `terminal-control`, `terminal-config` and `terminal-allocations`. | [terminal-control/spec.md](terminal-control/spec.md) |
| Process Facts & Control (L0) | Single authority for "is this process tuple `{host, bootId, pidNs, pid, startTime}` alive, dead or unknown" (`judge`, one shared vector file for Rust and Node), for signalling a process by identity (`pidfd` on Linux, never a bare pid), for spawning with an explicit fd mapping, and for the domain primitives `domain_is_empty`/`domain_kill_all` the predecessor rule of holder-lock needs. Never spawns to read facts, never kills by bare pid, never reads mtime, knows no run, lock or pane. Rust crate `fgos-process` (`packages/process/rust`), one driver per OS; the Node leaf `src/runner/dispatch/process-identity.mjs` reads the same vectors, and reconcile imports only `facts`. The gate primitives (subreaper, PDEATHSIG, PID namespace, tty) stay with the run supervisor; the containment port lives in this crate (row below). Depends only on the OS. | [process/spec.md](process/spec.md) |
| Holder-lock (L1) | Single authority for "who holds which resource", as the kernel sees it: kernel locks on open file descriptions behind one OS-neutral port (`acquire`, `release`, `run_borrowed`, `probe`, `holders`, `guarantee`), the lock registry (`packages/holder-lock/contracts/lock-registry.v1.json`: every lock's kind, scope, rank, path, legacy shape and fence), lock order inside one `LockScope`, the description rules, the predecessor-domain rule, the single state-root resolution and the cutover fences. Never reads writer identity, never takes a lock from a live holder, never derives a decision from a pid, TTL or mtime. Rust crate `fgos-holder-lock` (`packages/holder-lock/rust`) plus the internal routes `fgos internal lock-fd|state-root|quiesce-scan|lock-borrow-vectors`; Node only through the facade `src/holder-lock/`, which never exposes an fd. Depends on Process Facts & Control and the kernel. Owns the cold locks (gateway, runner, sessions, advance, reconcile, recovery, full-suite, provider account/state, dispatch cwd) and the main checkout mutex (one door `withMainCheckout`, git children and the pre-commit hook borrow the lock through the description, no pid or TTL), the merge slot and `worktree-admin`; `fgos lock fence` is the one door for a hung live holder. It does not own the state store's hot mutex (`state`, `porting-events`: `withStateTx` in `src/state/hot-lock.mjs`, which replaced `events.lock`, `claims.lock` and `porting/events.lock`): the state store owns that mechanism, a temporary one until the store moves to Rust, and takes only its cleanup lock and the fences from this component. The main door's `.fgos` checkpoint is a detachable adapter, so the lock core knows nothing of the event log. | [holder-lock/spec.md](holder-lock/spec.md) |
| Containment port (L0) | Single authority for "which processes belong to this attempt, and are there any left": an OS-neutral process domain per attempt (`create`, `spawn_in`, `is_empty`, `kill_all`, `guarantee`) with one driver per OS (`bwrap-pidns` and `linux-pgroup` on Linux, `windows-job`, `macos-tree`), each reporting a guarantee level (`kernel` or `best-effort`) and its named escapes. Knows no attempt beyond the id that names a domain, and no envelope, lock or pane. Module `containment` of the Rust crate `fgos-process` (`packages/process/rust`), contract `packages/process/contracts/containment.port.v1.json`; depends only on the OS. | [process/spec.md](process/spec.md#10-containment-port) |
| Git (foundation) | Single authority for repository facts, typed Git operations and their recovery WAL: every fgOS mutation of local objects, refs, index, worktrees and worktree registration, the local side of fetch and push, and operation recovery, through typed ports (Inspect, Refs, Worktree, ScopedCommit, Sync, Land, SafeRestore, RepositoryConfig, Remote, Recovery, Publication); no public `git(args)` port. Its Publication port is the only door to `refs/fgos/*`, and Event Store is the only production writer of event refs through it. Owns no business approval, Work lifecycle, event semantics or lock mechanism. Consumers: Workflow, Execution Core, Work, Event Store, setup. Depends on Holder-lock, Process Facts & Control and Session Identity; imports no consumer. Rust crate `fgos-git` (`packages/git/rust`, planned); Node reaches it only through the one combined N-API addon that also links `fgos-event-store`. Not implemented: today's Node git writers stay until the Git plan replaces them in one release per caller family. | [git/spec.md](git/spec.md) |
| Event Store | Signed design D-ADR0055; implementation not started. Owns event durability after `fsync`, sealing immutable git objects on per-machine `refs/fgos/events/<machine-id>`, publication/sync and deterministic union reads. One Rust core with a thin Node facade; consumer reducers and rebuildable views remain with consumers, claims/leases remain runtime state. Uses Process and Holder-lock; planned `event-seal` rank 58 and `event-append` rank 70 are specified, not yet registered or implemented. Work is the first consumer; porting, observe and decisions follow. Acceptance requires spec §23 gates; no current state-store ownership transfer is claimed. | [event-store/spec.md](event-store/spec.md) |
| Run Supervisor (L4) | One Rust process per attempt that owns the attempt after the controller handed it over: holds the attempt lock and the cwd lease, creates the containment domain, starts the launch gate, watches the soft deadline and idle, publishes the receipt and the per-step receipts, runs the post-receipt steps and owns the adopt door (`fgos internal adopt`, one door for resume, recover, scan and home cleanup). A supervisor that dies leaves the agent running; adopt settles it. Never knows a pane or a terminal, never picks a provider or retries, never judges the work (Run Result Evaluator inside the Node `settle-attempt` step). Crate `fgos-run-supervisor` (`packages/run-supervisor/rust`), routes `fgos internal supervise\|gate\|adopt\|attempt-step` (protocol 1, not in help), Node client and steps in `src/run-supervisor/`. Depends on Containment port, Process Facts & Control, Holder-lock and agent-protocol. Two launch modes: `direct` (headless process) and `terminal` (an agent in a terminal-control pane, addressed by the attempt id; the supervisor listens on an attempt socket, drives the pane through the agent protocol and ends with a `release-slot` step). Depends also on Terminal-control (in process, by key). | [run-supervisor/spec.md](run-supervisor/spec.md) |
| Launch gate (L4, part of the run supervisor) | The process root of the agent inside the containment domain (pid 1 of a fresh PID namespace on Linux): owns the agent's IO (capture files, stdin; in `terminal` mode the pane's tty, with the agent as foreground group), refuses to run the agent without GO (in `terminal` mode GO arrives over the attempt socket with the attempt lock and cwd lease as `SCM_RIGHTS`, the peer uid is checked, and the gate runs in the pane, so the gate holds the attempt lock and outlives a dead supervisor), applies the environment scrub and the attempt writer id, reaps every orphan with `waitpid(-1)` for the whole attempt, enforces the hard ceiling (SIGTERM, `dispatch.gateKillGraceMs`, SIGKILL) on its own clock and publishes `gate-exit.json` once the domain is empty. `fgos internal gate`; same crate and spec as the supervisor. | [run-supervisor/spec.md](run-supervisor/spec.md#5-supervisor-and-gate) |
| Agent protocol (L3) | Pure per-CLI adapters (claude, codex, agy, pi, omp) that read what an agent CLI showed (capture tail, exit, outbox) and name the result (`completed`, `blocked(login\|trust-dialog\|usage-limit)`, `needs-human`, `exited`); decide stdin policy and the activity source for idle. Never builds argv (that stays with the executor configuration through `resolveExecutorCommand`), never retries, no dependency on terminal-control, locks or attempts. Direct and terminal adapters; the terminal ones read the pane through `AgentIo` (`screen`, `inspect`) wired by the supervisor to terminal-control. Crate `fgos-agent-protocol` (`packages/agent-protocol/rust`). | [agent-protocol/spec.md](agent-protocol/spec.md) |

resolvedPassage.text:
| Component | Current role | Current source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Work Lifecycle Engine / Work Driver | Domain-agnostic work-unit lifecycle, status board, claim/return, human gates. Does not own stage or sequencing (D-ADR0070 (workflow guide + admission ledger), [workflow.md](../specs/workflow.md)): execution and progress authority for a case on the ledger is the Workflow case, and Work keeps the status lifecycle, claim/return, slots, settlement and the `workflowRunId` pointer; the coding step FSM stays the authority for coding items until the coding cutover. Owns worker slots (`OccupancyPort`), and fail-safe claim settlement (`fgos return --to blocked`). | [../architect/component-boundary/component-boundary-advisory.md](../architect/component-boundary/component-boundary-advisory.md) |
| Workflow (guide + case; `src/workflow/**`) | Component Workflow with two entities, guide and case (D-ADR0070 (workflow guide + admission ledger), partially supersedes 0048 §2 and 0049 §4; behaviour per [workflow.md](../specs/workflow.md), implementation follows its plan). Human review gates. A consumer of Git's Land and Sync; owns no git mutation of its own. Single authority for the guide schema and its pinned snapshot per case; the case ledger (approved frame, reservations, route/deviation events, gate answers bound to subject digests, receipts, milestone projection, close); admission (is a proposed activity lawful now, against a closed catalog of machine checks); the worktree binding record (keyed by worktree root identity, with a generation) and the frame counters. Implements the AdmissionPort that Execution Core declares; imports flow Workflow → Execution Core only. Chooses no order: the agent proposes, the case admits and records; the Playbook proposer proposes through admission like any agent. Admission predicates, projection and the port implementation sit at infra or lower; the Playbook proposer at use-case. The ledger stays the JSONL under `advance`, hardened in place (fsync before release, reader fails closed); not an Event Store consumer in this cutover (owner 2026-10-19). Consumer of Execution Core and Git. Never owns who/model/persona, verify execution, locks, writer identity, merge or Work status. | [../specs/workflow.md](../specs/workflow.md), [../specs/runner.md](../specs/runner.md) |
| Execution Core (Unit, Unit run, `bind()`, Pattern cộng tác, cửa `fgos run`, posture) | Single authority for "ai làm / model / persona / cơ chế" (`src/runner/execution/bind.mjs`), single run door for new work (`fgos run` via `src/runner/execution/run.mjs`, herdr pane default, cli fallback), OS confinement posture for both herdr and cli, verifiable mutating gate. Strictly forbids L3 Work lifecycle dependencies (`src/state/**`). Owns the AdmissionPort interface (D-ADR0070 (workflow guide + admission ledger), [workflow.md](../specs/workflow.md)) (resolve the target worktree's binding, admit, settle), never the admission decision; every `runUnit` caller with writes (the run door, the Playbook proposer and the Work paths running today) injects Workflow's real implementation from the day it lands, and the port accepts an `advance` hold the caller already has. `runUnit` refuses a mutating Unit with no port, and a standalone write passes only on an affirmative `unbound`. The door resolves the caller's authority context conjunctively after pattern resolution and before `bind()`; the port stays present at the mutating gate, which re-checks subject-bound consent at effect; the door sets the case context in the worker's launch env and strips any inherited one. A nested writing dispatch from a confined worker is refused by name (owner 2026-10-19). | [../specs/runner.md](../specs/runner.md) |
| Collaboration Patterns (Execution Core) | Domain-neutral small collaboration loops (`solo`, `reviewed`, `panel`) and presets (`consult`, `research-fan-out`, `rfc`). Replaces retired coordination engine. | [../specs/runner.md](../specs/runner.md) |
| Herdr (Transport chính + Bề mặt quan sát) | Transport mặc định cho out-of-process runs, pane execution liveness, plugin `herdr-dashboard/` (TUI trong pane herdr + pick/pane supervisor; herdr nạp qua `herdr-plugin.toml`). | [../specs/herdr-web-dashboard.md](../specs/herdr-web-dashboard.md) |
| fgos Gateway | Tiến trình detached duy nhất phục vụ REST API (`/v1`, hợp đồng CTR010), MCP `search`/`execute` trên cùng cổng, và bundle web dashboard nhúng sẵn (`apps/fgos-gateway/`: `gateway.rs`, `mcp.rs`, `cf_access.rs`, `remote_invocation.rs`, `web/`). Vòng đời duy nhất qua `fgos gateway start\|status\|stop`; không phải một phần của herdr và không phải "herdr-gateway" (tên đó chỉ repo tham chiếu ngoài). Dùng chung với `herdr-dashboard` lớp adapter CLI fgos tại `packages/herdr-fgos-common/rust` (`fgos.rs`, `settings.rs`, trait `WorkItemSource`). | [../specs/herdr-web-dashboard.md](../specs/herdr-web-dashboard.md) |
| Dispatch Transport & Confinement | Machine backend registry, isolation confinement (`bwrap` v1 driver, attestation storage, fail-closed probes), executor adapters; the `bwrap` driver calls the credential renewal module at provisioning (`copyCredentialFiles`, the write-back marker) and removing a private home (`confinement/cleanup.mjs`) calls it again for write-back (dependency confinement → provider capacity, for the account lock only). | [../specs/confinement-authority.md](../specs/confinement-authority.md) |
| Run Result Evaluator | Evidence/confidence boundary for assignment run results. | [../architect/agent-coordination/architecture/evidence-and-results.md](../architect/agent-coordination/architecture/evidence-and-results.md) |
| Domain Components And Extension Layer | Domain-specific behavior, workflows, skills, task specs, doctrine. L2 prose no longer picks executors or mechanisms (lớp matching L2 cũ đã thu hồi per 0048); thin driver `fgos-run` delegates directly to Workflow runner and P1 Execution Core. | [../../domains/](../../domains/), [../architect/domainization/](../architect/domainization/) |
| Host And Surface Layer | CLI, fgos Gateway (REST/MCP/web), `herdr-dashboard` plugin and other Herdr surfaces into platform engines. | Host invocation and gateway docs |
| Packaging-Distribution | Runtime packaging, install, activation, setup/doctor readiness. | [packaging-distribution/README.md](packaging-distribution/README.md) |
| Knowledge, Learning, And Documentation Registry | Retrospective learning, doc registry, end-user docs index, trace/evolve signals. | Knowledge and docs registry docs |
| Observe (Metrics & Friction) | Measurement and friction tracking across substrate entities (cases, runs, sessions, friction, snapshots). Owned in Rust (`packages/observe/rust`), native routing. | [../specs/observe.md](../specs/observe.md) |
| Convention (Executable Names & Placement) | Platform-core authority for deterministic artifact names, repository-relative placement, path classification, and conformance checking. Implemented; owns no state and depends only on `fgos-host-runtime`. | [convention/spec.md](convention/spec.md) |
| Session Identity (Writer Identity) | Foundation authority for "who is the writer of this process" (`{id, source}`). One implementation, the Rust crate `fgos-session-identity` (`packages/session-identity/rust`, native verb `fgos identity`); Observe calls it in process, Node through the facade `src/util/session-identity.mjs`. Also mints the writer id of an attempt (`att-<attemptId>`, route `fgos internal identity mint-attempt`) and carries the launcher's env scrub the gate applies. Owns no state and depends only on `fgos-host-runtime`; Observe depends on it; the run supervisor's controller half calls the mint. Grants no lock or claim authority. | [session-identity/spec.md](session-identity/spec.md) |
| Terminal-control (L2) | Foundation component for "which pane does this key run in" on a terminal multiplexer, usable without a run. Rust crate `fgos-terminal-control` (`packages/terminal-control/rust`) with a key-addressed upper port and a driver port with declared capabilities (herdr first; Windows declares none). Writes only the allocation record; closes only panes it allocated, never a tab; Node reaches it through the internal route `fgos internal terminal-control`, no user verb. Dependency one way: run supervisor → Terminal-control (the supervisor holds the key, the attempt id, never a pane). Node migration done; setup adds the `terminal` config section and `<stateRoot>/terminal`, doctor runs `terminal-control`, `terminal-config` and `terminal-allocations`. | [terminal-control/spec.md](terminal-control/spec.md) |
| Process Facts & Control (L0) | Single authority for "is this process tuple `{host, bootId, pidNs, pid, startTime}` alive, dead or unknown" (`judge`, one shared vector file for Rust and Node), for signalling a process by identity (`pidfd` on Linux, never a bare pid), for spawning with an explicit fd mapping, and for the domain primitives `domain_is_empty`/`domain_kill_all` the predecessor rule of holder-lock needs. Never spawns to read facts, never kills by bare pid, never reads mtime, knows no run, lock or pane. Rust crate `fgos-process` (`packages/process/rust`), one driver per OS; the Node leaf `src/runner/dispatch/process-identity.mjs` reads the same vectors, and reconcile imports only `facts`. The gate primitives (subreaper, PDEATHSIG, PID namespace, tty) stay with the run supervisor; the containment port lives in this crate (row below). Depends only on the OS. | [process/spec.md](process/spec.md) |
| Holder-lock (L1) | Single authority for "who holds which resource", as the kernel sees it: kernel locks on open file descriptions behind one OS-neutral port (`acquire`, `release`, `run_borrowed`, `probe`, `holders`, `guarantee`), the lock registry (`packages/holder-lock/contracts/lock-registry.v1.json`: every lock's kind, scope, rank, path, legacy shape and fence), lock order inside one `LockScope`, the description rules, the predecessor-domain rule, the single state-root resolution and the cutover fences. Never reads writer identity, never takes a lock from a live holder, never derives a decision from a pid, TTL or mtime. Rust crate `fgos-holder-lock` (`packages/holder-lock/rust`) plus the internal routes `fgos internal lock-fd|state-root|quiesce-scan|lock-borrow-vectors`; Node only through the facade `src/holder-lock/`, which never exposes an fd. Depends on Process Facts & Control and the kernel. Owns the cold locks (gateway, runner, sessions, advance, reconcile, recovery, full-suite, provider account/state, dispatch cwd) and the main checkout mutex (one door `withMainCheckout`, git children and the pre-commit hook borrow the lock through the description, no pid or TTL), the merge slot and `worktree-admin`; `fgos lock fence` is the one door for a hung live holder. `advance` follows Shape C (D-ADR0070 (workflow guide + admission ledger), owner 2026-10-19, [workflow.md](../specs/workflow.md)): a conductor case holds it for one reserve or one release/settle; the Playbook proposer holds it for the life of its loop, so its holder is the proposer's liveness, as today; a dispatch naming a live playbook case from inside its own Unit is refused by name. `answer` never appends directly: it writes the gate-answer file and tries `advance` once. The worktree binding is one exclusively created file per worktree, not a registry row. No new lock row; rank stays 80; no re-rank for an Event Store cutover. It does not own the state store's hot mutex (`state`, `porting-events`: `withStateTx` in `src/state/hot-lock.mjs`, which replaced `events.lock`, `claims.lock` and `porting/events.lock`): the state store owns that mechanism, a temporary one until the store moves to Rust, and takes only its cleanup lock and the fences from this component. The main door's `.fgos` checkpoint is a detachable adapter, so the lock core knows nothing of the event log. | [holder-lock/spec.md](holder-lock/spec.md) |
| Containment port (L0) | Single authority for "which processes belong to this attempt, and are there any left": an OS-neutral process domain per attempt (`create`, `spawn_in`, `is_empty`, `kill_all`, `guarantee`) with one driver per OS (`bwrap-pidns` and `linux-pgroup` on Linux, `windows-job`, `macos-tree`), each reporting a guarantee level (`kernel` or `best-effort`) and its named escapes. Knows no attempt beyond the id that names a domain, and no envelope, lock or pane. Module `containment` of the Rust crate `fgos-process` (`packages/process/rust`), contract `packages/process/contracts/containment.port.v1.json`; depends only on the OS. | [process/spec.md](process/spec.md#10-containment-port) |
| Git (foundation) | Single authority for repository facts, typed Git operations and their recovery WAL: every fgOS mutation of local objects, refs, index, worktrees and worktree registration, the local side of fetch and push, and operation recovery, through typed ports (Inspect, Refs, Worktree, ScopedCommit, Sync, Land, SafeRestore, RepositoryConfig, Remote, Recovery, Publication); no public `git(args)` port. Its Publication port is the only door to `refs/fgos/*`, and Event Store is the only production writer of event refs through it. Owns no business approval, Work lifecycle, event semantics or lock mechanism. Consumers: Workflow, Execution Core, Work, Event Store, setup. Depends on Holder-lock, Process Facts & Control and Session Identity; imports no consumer. Rust crate `fgos-git` (`packages/git/rust`, planned); Node reaches it only through the one combined N-API addon that also links `fgos-event-store`. Not implemented: today's Node git writers stay until the Git plan replaces them in one release per caller family. | [git/spec.md](git/spec.md) |
| Event Store | Signed design D-ADR0055; implementation not started. Owns event durability after `fsync`, sealing immutable git objects on per-machine `refs/fgos/events/<machine-id>`, publication/sync and deterministic union reads. One Rust core with a thin Node facade; consumer reducers and rebuildable views remain with consumers, claims/leases remain runtime state. Uses Process and Holder-lock; planned `event-seal` rank 58 and `event-append` rank 70 are specified, not yet registered or implemented. Work is the first consumer; porting, observe and decisions follow. Acceptance requires spec §23 gates; no current state-store ownership transfer is claimed. | [event-store/spec.md](event-store/spec.md) |
| Run Supervisor (L4) | One Rust process per attempt that owns the attempt after the controller handed it over: holds the attempt lock and the cwd lease, creates the containment domain, starts the launch gate, watches the soft deadline and idle, publishes the receipt and the per-step receipts, runs the post-receipt steps and owns the adopt door (`fgos internal adopt`, one door for resume, recover, scan and home cleanup). A supervisor that dies leaves the agent running; adopt settles it. Never knows a pane or a terminal, never picks a provider or retries, never judges the work (Run Result Evaluator inside the Node `settle-attempt` step). Crate `fgos-run-supervisor` (`packages/run-supervisor/rust`), routes `fgos internal supervise\|gate\|adopt\|attempt-step` (protocol 1, not in help), Node client and steps in `src/run-supervisor/`. Depends on Containment port, Process Facts & Control, Holder-lock and agent-protocol. Two launch modes: `direct` (headless process) and `terminal` (an agent in a terminal-control pane, addressed by the attempt id; the supervisor listens on an attempt socket, drives the pane through the agent protocol and ends with a `release-slot` step). Depends also on Terminal-control (in process, by key). | [run-supervisor/spec.md](run-supervisor/spec.md) |
| Launch gate (L4, part of the run supervisor) | The process root of the agent inside the containment domain (pid 1 of a fresh PID namespace on Linux): owns the agent's IO (capture files, stdin; in `terminal` mode the pane's tty, with the agent as foreground group), refuses to run the agent without GO (in `terminal` mode GO arrives over the attempt socket with the attempt lock and cwd lease as `SCM_RIGHTS`, the peer uid is checked, and the gate runs in the pane, so the gate holds the attempt lock and outlives a dead supervisor), applies the environment scrub and the attempt writer id, reaps every orphan with `waitpid(-1)` for the whole attempt, enforces the hard ceiling (SIGTERM, `dispatch.gateKillGraceMs`, SIGKILL) on its own clock and publishes `gate-exit.json` once the domain is empty. `fgos internal gate`; same crate and spec as the supervisor. | [run-supervisor/spec.md](run-supervisor/spec.md#5-supervisor-and-gate) |
| Agent protocol (L3) | Pure per-CLI adapters (claude, codex, agy, pi, omp) that read what an agent CLI showed (capture tail, exit, outbox) and name the result (`completed`, `blocked(login\|trust-dialog\|usage-limit)`, `needs-human`, `exited`); decide stdin policy and the activity source for idle. Never builds argv (that stays with the executor configuration through `resolveExecutorCommand`), never retries, no dependency on terminal-control, locks or attempts. Direct and terminal adapters; the terminal ones read the pane through `AgentIo` (`screen`, `inspect`) wired by the supervisor to terminal-control. Crate `fgos-agent-protocol` (`packages/agent-protocol/rust`). | [agent-protocol/spec.md](agent-protocol/spec.md) |
